text:
marie: quick heads-up thread for vendor roadmap sync re: H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. main asks: confirm press cadence, marketplace image readiness, SI handoff gating, and any firmware/driver blockers.

sam: prefer 2-wave announce: Wave A (H100/H200/B200) then Wave B (MI300, Gaudi) 10-14 days later. Pros: reduces press collisions + gives SI time. cons?

nvidia_pr: H200 firmware candidate landing next week but still in security review. if security sign-off slips, H200 GA may need a short hold. H100 unaffected.

diego: MI300 has a dependency on our cuda/rocm compat tests; a subset of SIs are still on 5.15 kernels. we can provide backports but need a clear checklist.

jess: marketplace ops note 1: we require marketplace image + release notes 72h ahead for region-specific listings. also want a short rollback playbook in the listing metadata.

kai: ops capacity: Gaudi soak currently blocked by rack power constraints week of Jun 24. we can re-schedule or procure two extra boards if budget approves.

intel_partner: MI300 driver team can expedite ABI compatibility tests if Redwood shares a small customer-run test harness by Tue. we can parallelize.

marie: okay - sounds like we can do Wave A on target if H200 sign-off holds. Wave B contingent on MI300/ Gaudi soak + driver checks. want explicit gating criteria.

jess: propose gating matrix (short form):
- pressing green: firmware signed + security review complete
- marketplace green: images built, checksums uploaded, release-notes present (72h)
- SI green: drivers validated against canary images, kernel backport notes in SI repo
(we'll push full matrix doc after thread)

sam: naming convention for pre-GA images to avoid accidental pull: rwinf-<vendor>_<model>-preprod-YYYYMMDD-<tag>. example: rwinf-nvidia_h200-preprod-20240612-v1

diego: add .sha256 file alongside image and a small md5 quick-run script for SIs. they often forget checksum parity.

kai: i'll try to get two Gaudi cards into lab (ops OK pending budget). will update by EOD Wed. if denied, we shift Gaudi wave +7 days.

nvidia_pr: we'll try to compress security review, but no promises. i'll flag legal and sec to prioritize H200.

marie: fallback plan if MI300 drivers slip: marketplace entry will include a compatibility note and Dedicated routing policy to auto-failover to H100-class variants for affected customers. ops + product to confirm routing behavior.

jess: schedule: sam to publish proposed wave dates tomorrow; diego to draft SI checklist; kai to confirm lab availability; vendor PRs to commit by Tue.

sam: i'll circulate a calendar invite with proposed dates and gating matrix draft by 18:00 PDT.

diego: will add kernel backport steps + sample commands to SI repo. example snippet for backport instruction:
```
# example backport steps (illustrative)
sudo apt-get install -y linux-headers-6.1.0-rc1
git clone https://github.com/rw-inference/si-kernel-patches.git
./scripts/apply-backport.sh --target 6.1
```

intel_partner: we'll prepare a small harness and doc, expecting diego's checklist to wire into it.

marketplace_ops_bot: reminder set: publish-checklist reminder for sam at 2024-06-18 16:00 UTC.

marie: final ask 1 - react with :white_check_mark: next to your action, and add any additional risks in thread. will pull this into partner playbook after alignment.

sam: :white_check_mark:

jess: :white_check_mark:

diego: :white_check_mark: (starting checklist now)

kai: pending ops approval

nvidia_pr: will update Tue after sec review

marie: thanks all. I'll consolidate and post a short one-pager once actions are in.
